meta.name: Fully Open Humanoid
meta.frame: X forward, Y left, Z up; ground at z = 0
meta.basis: Berkeley Humanoid Lite extended configuration (paper Fig. 5) on RobStride actuators

3DP_kit04_coupler.name: RS04 coupler (output hub)
3DP_kit04_coupler.notes: Sits on the RS04 output boss, located by 3 x Ø6 dowels; nine M5 x 25 pass through the child plate and this coupler into the boss (PCD 36). The Ø50 hub carries the 6810 support bearing. Print in PA-CF.

3DP_kit03_coupler.name: RS03 coupler (output hub)
3DP_kit03_coupler.notes: On the RS03 output boss, 3 x Ø4 dowels; six M4 x 30 through the child plate and coupler into the boss (PCD 30.36). Ø45 hub for the 6809 bearing.

3DP_kit06_coupler.name: RS06 coupler (output hub)
3DP_kit06_coupler.notes: On the RS06 output boss, 3 x Ø4 dowels; six M4 x 25 through the child plate and coupler (PCD 24). Ø35 hub for the 6807 bearing.

3DP_kit02_coupler.name: RS02 coupler (output hub)
3DP_kit02_coupler.notes: On the RS02 output boss, 3 x Ø4 dowels; six M4 x 25 through the child plate and coupler (PCD 24). Ø35 hub for the 6707 bearing.

3DP_kit05_adapter.name: RS05 output adapter
3DP_kit05_adapter.notes: Ø44 x 5 disc: 6 x M4 x 8 counterbored on PCD 24 into the RS05 output, 3 x M3 inserts on Ø34 for the wrist flange.

3DP_pel11_hip_cup.name: Hip-pitch cup
3DP_pel11_hip_cup.notes: RS04 mount ring (10 x M4 on PCD 106, 6810 pocket), collar straps open at the top, and a tab that bolts to the two pelvis bars with four M5 T-nuts.

3DP_leg21_hip_roll_bracket.name: Hip-roll bracket
3DP_leg21_hip_roll_bracket.notes: Plate on the hip-pitch coupler, web to the hip-roll RS03 cup: mount ring, straps and back plate, open on the inboard side.

3DP_leg22_hip_yaw_housing.name: Hip-yaw housing
3DP_leg22_hip_yaw_housing.notes: Front plate on the hip-roll coupler, RS03 mount ring and collar for the hip-yaw actuator (axis vertical, output down).

3DP_leg23_thigh_socket.name: Thigh socket
3DP_leg23_thigh_socket.notes: Plate on the hip-yaw coupler with the Ø30 tube socket below it: 40 mm bond length, two M4 cross bolts.

3DP_leg24_knee_cup.name: Knee cup
3DP_leg24_knee_cup.notes: Tube socket on top; full RS04 cup below: mount ring, collar, back plate and the Ø35 stub for the inner shank plate's bearing.

3DP_leg25_shank_yoke.name: Shank yoke
3DP_leg25_shank_yoke.notes: One print: outer plate on the knee coupler, inner plate on the stub bearing, cross member and the Ø30 tube socket under it.

3DP_leg26_ankle_cup.name: Ankle cup
3DP_leg26_ankle_cup.notes: Tube socket on top; RS03 ankle-pitch cup below with straps open to the front.

3DP_leg27_ankle_bracket.name: Ankle bracket
3DP_leg27_ankle_bracket.notes: Plate on the ankle-pitch coupler; RS06 mount ring, collar and back plate for the ankle-roll actuator behind the shank.

3DP_leg28_foot_bracket.name: Foot bracket
3DP_leg28_foot_bracket.notes: Upright on the ankle-roll coupler, base flange with 4 x M5 to the aluminium foot plate.

AL_FOOT_PLATE.name: Foot plate, 3 mm 6061, laser-cut, 250 x 100
AL_FOOT_PLATE.notes: Four M5 holes for the bracket, eight M4 for the sole. DXF generated from the model.

AL_TORSO_PLATE.name: Torso plate, 5 mm 6061, laser-cut, 170 x 220
AL_TORSO_PLATE.notes: Two per robot (bottom and top). Four M5 for the uprights, four M5 into the pelvis bars (bottom) or the head post (top).

3DP_tor14_shoulder_mount.name: Shoulder-pitch mount
3DP_tor14_shoulder_mount.notes: RS03 mount ring, collar and back plate hung from the top plate; the ring's front face is flush with the torso side.

PC_SIDE_PANEL.name: Torso side panel, 3 mm polycarbonate
PC_SIDE_PANEL.notes: Clearance hole for the shoulder-pitch coupler.

3DP_hea12_head_shell.name: Head shell
3DP_hea12_head_shell.notes: Blank head with a RealSense pocket. Camera optional.

3DP_arm21_shoulder_bracket.name: Shoulder-roll bracket
3DP_arm21_shoulder_bracket.notes: Plate on the shoulder-pitch coupler, beam outboard, full RS06 cup for the shoulder-roll actuator.

3DP_arm22_upper_arm_yoke.name: Upper-arm yoke
3DP_arm22_upper_arm_yoke.notes: Front plate on the shoulder-roll coupler, shelf under it, RS02 mount ring and collar for the shoulder-yaw actuator (output down).

3DP_arm23_upper_arm_socket.name: Upper-arm socket
3DP_arm23_upper_arm_socket.notes: Plate on the shoulder-yaw coupler with the Ø25 tube socket below it.

3DP_arm24_elbow_cup.name: Elbow cup
3DP_arm24_elbow_cup.notes: Tube socket on top; full RS02 cup with the Ø35 stub for the inner forearm plate.

3DP_arm25_forearm_yoke.name: Forearm yoke
3DP_arm25_forearm_yoke.notes: Outer plate on the elbow coupler, inner plate on the stub bearing, cross member and the Ø25 tube socket under it.

3DP_arm26_wrist_housing.name: Wrist housing
3DP_arm26_wrist_housing.notes: Tube socket on top; collar and rear plate around the RS05 (4 x M3 into its rear face).

3DP_arm27_hand_flange.name: Hand flange
3DP_arm27_hand_flange.notes: 50 x 50 x 6 plate: 3 x M3 to the RS05 adapter's inserts, four M3 inserts on a 25 mm square for the Amazing Hand's wrist. Confirm the hand's wrist pattern against Pollen's current CAD before printing.

KIT_AMAZING_HAND.name: Amazing Hand (Pollen Robotics), left or right
KIT_AMAZING_HAND.vendor: Pollen Robotics BOM (printed parts + 8 bus servos + board)
KIT_AMAZING_HAND.notes: 8-DOF printed hand, Apache-2.0, under 200 EUR in parts per Pollen. Its servo bus goes to the forearm's USB drop.

CF_TUBE_30.name: Carbon-fibre tube Ø30 x 26 mm, 3K roll-wrapped
CF_TUBE_30.notes: Thigh and shank links. One 1000 mm tube yields all four pieces. Bonded 40 mm into each socket with structural epoxy, plus two M4 cross bolts.

CF_TUBE_25.name: Carbon-fibre tube Ø25 x 22 mm, 3K roll-wrapped
CF_TUBE_25.notes: Upper-arm and forearm links. One 1000 mm tube yields all four pieces.

HW_2020_480.name: Aluminium 2020 extrusion, 480 mm, ends tapped M5

HW_2020_300.name: Aluminium 2020 extrusion, 300 mm
HW_2020_300.notes: Pelvis bars: the hip cups and the torso bottom plate bolt to them with T-nuts.

HW_6810_2RS.name: Ball bearing 6810-2RS, 50 x 65 x 7 mm
HW_6810_2RS.notes: Output support bearing of every RS04 joint, on the coupler hub.

HW_6809_2RS.name: Ball bearing 6809-2RS, 45 x 58 x 7 mm
HW_6809_2RS.notes: Output support bearing of every RS03 joint.

HW_6807_2RS.name: Ball bearing 6807-2RS, 35 x 47 x 7 mm
HW_6807_2RS.notes: Output support bearing of every RS06 joint.

HW_6707_2RS.name: Ball bearing 6707-2RS, 35 x 44 x 5 mm
HW_6707_2RS.notes: Output support bearing of every RS02 joint, and the inner-plate support bearing at the knees and elbows.

EL_PC_N100.name: Mini PC, Intel N100, 16 GB RAM, 500 GB SSD
EL_PC_N100.notes: Runs the 50 Hz policy and the 500 Hz motor loop. No GPU needed on the robot.

EL_BATTERY_6S.name: LiPo 6S 8000 mAh 100C, EC5
EL_BATTERY_6S.notes: Two in series: 44.4 V nominal, 50.4 V full. Zeee or equivalent.

EL_BUCK_12V.name: 48 V to 12 V buck converter, 10 A, encased
EL_BUCK_12V.notes: Feeds the computer, the hub and the gripper servos.

EL_DIST_BLOCK.name: Power distribution block with 60 A fuse
EL_DIST_BLOCK.notes: 48 V bus and ground bars; ANL/MIDI fuse on the pack lead.

EL_IMU.name: USB 9-axis AHRS IMU (SYD Dynamics TM171 or equivalent)
EL_IMU.notes: Mounted rigidly to the torso bottom plate, axes aligned with the base frame.

EL_ESTOP.name: E-stop, 22 mm mushroom, NC contact
EL_ESTOP.notes: Opens the 48 V bus contactor coil. Duke V2 shipped without one; do not.

EL_BREAKER.name: DC circuit breaker, 100 A, panel mount
EL_BREAKER.notes: Main disconnect and pack over-current protection.

EL_CONTACTOR.name: DC contactor, 100 A, 12 V coil
EL_CONTACTOR.notes: Switched by the E-stop loop; carries the motor bus.

EL_CAMERA_D435I.name: Intel RealSense D435i
EL_CAMERA_D435I.notes: Optional perception kit. Any USB camera fits the head pocket with an adapter.

ACT_RS04.name: RobStride RS04 quasi-direct-drive actuator
ACT_RS04.notes: 120 N·m peak, 40 N·m rated, Ø120 x 55.2 mm, 1420 g. Mounts by 10 x M4 on PCD 106; output 9 x M5 on PCD 36.

ACT_RS03.name: RobStride RS03 quasi-direct-drive actuator
ACT_RS03.notes: 60 N·m peak, 20 N·m rated, Ø98 x 56.6 mm, 880 g. Mounts by 8 x M4 on PCD 98; output 6 x M4 on PCD 30.36.

ACT_RS06.name: RobStride RS06 quasi-direct-drive actuator
ACT_RS06.notes: 36 N·m peak, 11 N·m rated, Ø84.5 x 49 mm, 621 g. Mounts by 8 x M3 on PCD 88; output 6 x M4 on PCD 24.

ACT_RS02.name: RobStride RS02 quasi-direct-drive actuator
ACT_RS02.notes: 17 N·m peak, 6 N·m rated, Ø65 x 41.5 mm, 405 g. Mounts by 9 x M3 on PCD 73; output 6 x M4 on PCD 24.

ACT_RS05.name: RobStride RS05 quasi-direct-drive actuator
ACT_RS05.notes: 5.5 N·m peak, 1.6 N·m rated, Ø46 x 44 mm, 191 g. Mounts by 8 x M3 on PCD 41.5; output 6 x M4 on PCD 24.
